Hi Claire —

Appreciate the packet. A few quick clarifications before I push this to our master-data queue: 

1) Legal name vs. mailing — for the vendor master we store both fields but the canonical (tax/legal) name and registered address must match W9. If mailing address differs, we'll set that as the invoicing address. Could you confirm which address on page 2 is the registered/legal address?

2) Beneficial owner — I see the declaration but need the beneficial owner's date of birth and percentage ownership for our compliance intake (we redact in record storage). If there are multiple owners, list each with percentage.

3) PO routing — we use an explicit PO remittance field. If Oxalis prefers invoices to go to procure@oxalisco.com but payments to go to ap@oxalisco.com, we'll set PO routing to procure@ and ACH remittance to ap@. Do you have a preferred email and a POC name/phone for AP?

Looping in Marcus Lin (tax) to confirm W9 sufficiency for 1099/TIN verification and to request any additional tax docs if needed. Jonas, once Claire confirms the address/tax owner info, can you create the vendor record (Vendor ID request) and set PO remittance to the appropriate contact?

Thanks,
